observation_probe_source:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "json"

module LegacyQueueProbe
  def emit_log(**args)
    estimate, reason, = estimate_record(*args.values_at(:item_uuid, :launch_uuid, :message, :level, :timestamp, :attachment))
    accepted = super
    File.open(ENV.fetch("LEGACY_PROBE_OUTPUT"), "a") do |file|
      file.puts(JSON.generate(kind: "admission", args: args, estimate: estimate, reason: reason,
                             encoded_json_bytes: JSON.generate(args).bytesize, accepted: accepted))
    end
    accepted
  end
end

module LegacyErrorProbe
  def emit_error_log(**args)
    error = args.fetch(:error)
    File.open(ENV.fetch("LEGACY_PROBE_OUTPUT"), "a") do |file|
      file.puts(JSON.generate(kind: "error", class: error.class.name, message: error.message, backtrace: error.backtrace))
    end
    super
  end
end

ReportportalCucumber::Service::QueueProcessor.prepend(LegacyQueueProbe)
ReportportalCucumber::Cucumber::Formatter.prepend(LegacyErrorProbe)

# frozen_string_literal: true

root = ENV.fetch("LEGACY_SOURCE_ROOT")
path = File.join(root, "spec/reportportal_cucumber/cucumber/m4a_public_delivery_integration_spec.rb")
source = if ENV["LEGACY_PORTABILITY_DRIVER"]
           require ENV.fetch("LEGACY_PORTABILITY_DRIVER")
           LegacyPortability.source(root, "spec/reportportal_cucumber/cucumber/m4a_public_delivery_integration_spec.rb")
         else
           File.read(path)
         end
needle = '        require "cucumber/cli/main"'
raise "probe injection drift" unless source.scan(needle).length == 1
source = source.sub(needle, needle + "\n        require '/tmp/rp-legacy-portability-probe.rb'")
eval(source, TOPLEVEL_BINDING, path)
